title: Dasakam 47 – Ulūkhalabandhanam
description: Yashoda’s attempt to bind child Krishna unfolds from a household moment into a meditation on divine freedom, compassion and praise.
translation_note: No vetted English stanza translation supplied; commentary preserves the numbered intake captions verbatim.

stanzas.sanskrit:
एकदा दधिविमाथकारिणीं
मातरं समुपसेदिवान् भवान् ।
स्तन्यलोलुपतया निवारय-
-न्नङ्कमेत्य पपिवान् पयोधरौ ॥ ४७-१ ॥
stanzas.stanza_roman:
ekadā dadhivimāthakāriṇīṃ
mātaraṃ samupasedivān bhavān |
stanyalolupatayā nivāraya-
-nnaṅkametya papivān payodharau || 47-1 ||
stanzas.commentary_en: One day, Yashoda was churning curd. Krishna was hungry and he obstructed her from churning and climbed up on her lap to drink milk.

stanzas.sanskrit:
अर्धपीतकुचकुड्मले त्वयि
स्निग्धहासमधुराननाम्बुजे ।
दुग्धमीश दहने परिस्रुतं
धर्तुमाशु जननी जगाम ते ॥ ४७-२ ॥
stanzas.stanza_roman:
ardhapītakucakuḍmale tvayi
snigdhahāsamadhurānanāmbuje |
dughdhamīśa dahane parisrutaṃ
dhartumāśu jananī jagāma te || 47-2 ||
stanzas.commentary_en:
Yashoda was feeding Krishna with all her love looking at his lotus face and the charming smile. 
Mother Yashodha went away in a haste to quickly hold the milk which had overflown on the fire, leaving Krishna down.

stanzas.sanskrit:
सामिपीतरसभङ्गसङ्गत-
-क्रोधभारपरिभूतचेतसा ।
मन्थदण्डमुपगृह्य पाटितं
हन्त देव दधिभाजनं त्वया ॥ ४७-३ ॥
stanzas.stanza_roman:
sāmipītarasabhaṅgasaṅgata-
-krodhabhāraparibhūtacetasā |
manthadaṇḍamupagṛhya pāṭitaṃ
hanta deva dadhibhājanaṃ tvayā || 47-3 ||
stanzas.commentary_en: Krishna dissatisfied with mother leaving him hungry, took the churning rod and broke the butter pot with it in a fit of rage.

stanzas.sanskrit:
उच्चलद्ध्वनितमुच्चकैस्तदा
सन्निशम्य जननी समादृता ।
त्वद्यशोविसरवद्ददर्श सा
सद्य एव दधि विस्तृतं क्षितौ ॥ ४७-४ ॥
stanzas.stanza_roman:
uccaladdhvanitamuccakaistadā
sanniśamya jananī samādṛtā |
tvadyaśovisaravaddadarśa sā
sadya eva dadhi vistṛtaṃ kṣitau || 47-4 ||
stanzas.commentary_en: Hearing the sound of pot breaking, Yashoda came running from the kitchen. She saw the broken pot and curd spread all over the floor, just like how Krishna's fame spreads in the universe.

stanzas.sanskrit:
वेदमार्गपरिमार्गितं रुषा
त्वामवीक्ष्य परिमार्गयन्त्यसौ ।
सन्ददर्श सुकृतिन्युलूखले
दीयमाननवनीतमोतवे ॥ ४७-५ ॥
stanzas.stanza_roman:
vedamārgaparimārgitaṃ ruṣā
tvāmavīkṣya parimārgayantyasau |
sandadarśa sukṛtinyulūkhale
dīyamānanavanītamotave || 47-5 ||
stanzas.commentary_en: Sages search and get the vision of the Bhagwan through the path of vedas. Such Bhagwan was not spotted by mother Yashoda. Later she found him standing near the mortar and distributing butter to cat.

stanzas.sanskrit:
त्वां प्रगृह्य बत भीतिभावना-
-भासुराननसरोजमाशु सा ।
रोषरूषितमुखी सखीपुरो
बन्धनाय रशनामुपाददे ॥ ४७-६ ॥
stanzas.stanza_roman:
tvāṃ pragṛhya bata bhītibhāvanā-
-bhāsurānanasarojamāśu sā |
roṣarūṣitamukhī sakhīpuro
bandhanāya raśanāmupādade || 47-6 ||
stanzas.commentary_en: Her face quivered with anger, caught hold of Krishna who was having a sweet lotus like face, with fake fear. She looked for rope to tie the mischievous boy to the mortar even while her friends were watching the scene.

stanzas.sanskrit:
बन्धुमिच्छति यमेव सज्जन-
-स्तं भवन्तमयि बन्धुमिच्छती ।
सा नियुज्य रशनागुणान्बहून्
द्व्यङ्गुलोनमखिलं किलैक्षत ॥ ४७-७ ॥
stanzas.stanza_roman:
bandhumicchati yameva sajjana-
-staṃ bhavantamayi bandhumicchatī |
sā niyujya raśanāguṇānbahūn
dvyaṅgulonamakhilaṃ kilaikṣata || 47-7 ||
stanzas.commentary_en: The learned Brahmins and sages seek moksha by attaching themselves with Bhagwan. But here, Yashoda was trying to tie Krishna to the mortar. The rope fell short of two inches everytime she tried to increase the length by attaching some more rope.

stanzas.sanskrit:
विस्मितोत्स्मितसखीजनेक्षितां
स्विन्नसन्नवपुषं निरीक्ष्य ताम् ।
नित्यमुक्तवपुरप्यहो हरे
बन्धमेव कृपयान्वमन्यथाः ॥ ४७-८ ॥
stanzas.stanza_roman:
vismitotsmitasakhījanekṣitāṃ
svinnasannavapuṣaṃ nirīkṣya tām |
nityamuktavapurapyaho hare
bandhameva kṛpayānvamanyathāḥ || 47-8 ||
stanzas.commentary_en: While the wonder struck gopikas were watching Yashoda struggling to tie Krishna, she became too tired and exhausted. Krishna,the one who is free from all ties, out of compassion for the mother, allowed her to finally tie him to the mortar.

stanzas.sanskrit:
स्थीयतां चिरमुलूखले खले-
-त्यागता भवनमेव सा यदा ।
प्रागुलूखलबिलान्तरे तदा
सर्पिरर्पितमदन्नवास्थिथाः ॥ ४७-९ ॥
stanzas.stanza_roman:
sthīyatāṃ ciramulūkhale khale-
-tyāgatā bhavanameva sā yadā |
prāgulūkhalabilāntare tadā
sarpirarpitamadannavāsthithāḥ || 47-9 ||
stanzas.commentary_en: Yashoda told Krishna to remain tied to mortar for long time and went to do her chores. After mother went away, Krishna took the butter, which he had kept in the hole in the mortar before and kept eating it.

stanzas.sanskrit:
यद्यपाशसुगमो विभो भवान्
सम्यतः किमु सपाशयाऽनया ।
एवमादि दिविजैरभिष्टुतो
वातनाथ परिपाहि मां गदात् ॥ ४७-१० ॥
stanzas.stanza_roman:
yadyapāśasugamo vibho bhavān
samyataḥ kimu sapāśayā’nayā |
evamādi divijairabhiṣṭuto
vātanātha paripāhi māṃ gadāt || 47-10 ||
stanzas.commentary_en: Only people who have no desires can reach Bhagwan. Still yashoda was able to bind him. Devas and Gods in heaven sung in glory to Bhagwan.
